$ container --version
container CLI version 1.4.1

# Taken 2026-09-26 by asking the runtime directly (a two-line Dockerfile,
# `FROM scratch` and a COPY). The tag is refused before anything is built, so
# nothing but the runtime's own words is on stderr, the usage text after them;
# stdout is 0 bytes and the exit code is 64 (a usage error), not 1.
#
# The first line is the one that names the image: `Error: invalid reference <the
# name as given>`. The lines after it are `container build`'s usage, which says
# nothing about a name.

# -t Abc/Def:V1
$ container build -t Abc/Def:V1 .
--- exit code: 64
--- stderr (last 3 lines) ---
Error: invalid reference Abc/Def:V1
Usage: container build [<options>] [<context-dir>]
  See 'container build --help' for more information.

# -t org/App:v1
$ container build -t org/App:v1 .
--- exit code: 64
--- stderr (last 3 lines) ---
Error: invalid reference org/App:v1
Usage: container build [<options>] [<context-dir>]
  See 'container build --help' for more information.
